# `usage_pool_threshold`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

A data pool threshold (80% or 100%) reached by an account in a pool period: one row is one event, once per account, period and threshold. The notifications slice reads it.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `period_start` | `date` | no |  | First date of the pool period: the billing month starting on the account's bill cycle day. |
| `threshold` | `smallint` | no |  |  |
| `period_end` | `date` | no |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The pool member whose record reached the threshold; the message names its line. |
| `usage_record_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The record that reached it (no foreign key: usage_record is partitioned and old partitions are dropped). |
| `used` | `bigint` | no |  | Domestic data of every member in the period when the threshold was reached, in bytes. |
| `included` | `bigint` | no |  | The pool size on the record's date, in bytes (MB x 1048576). |
| `reached_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
